000100 IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
000200 PROGRAM-ID. GREETER.
000300* Fixed-format comment line.
000400 DATA DIVISION.
000500 WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
000600 01 WS-NAME     PIC X(20) VALUE "world".
000700 01 WS-COUNT    PIC 9(4) COMP VALUE ZERO.
000800 01 WS-QUOTED   PIC X(10) VALUE 'it''s'.
000900 PROCEDURE DIVISION.
001000     PERFORM VARYING WS-COUNT FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-COUNT > 3
001100         DISPLAY "Hello, " WS-NAME *> inline comment
001200     END-PERFORM
001300     IF WS-COUNT IS GREATER THAN 2 AND NOT WS-NAME = SPACES
001400         COMPUTE WS-COUNT = WS-COUNT * 2 + 1
001500     END-IF
001600     STOP RUN.
